traits.name: Consumptive Aura
traits.text: (aura, divine); 20 feet. A meladaemon emanates an aura of intense hunger. Each round a creature begins its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC 27 Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature takes 1d6 (1d6) negative damage (2d6 (2d6) on a critical failure) and becomes fatigued. This fatigue ends as soon as the creature eats any food.

traits.name: Withering Opportunity
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The meladaemon is attacked by an adjacent creature and the attack misses Effect The meladaemon swipes at the triggering creature, which must immediately attempt a save against the meladaemon's withering touch.

traits.name: Daemonic Famine
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 29 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier (1 day) Stage 2 enfeebled 1 (1 day) Stage 3 enfeebled 2 (1 day) Stage 4 as stage 3 (null) Stage 5 enfeebled 3 (1 week)

traits.name: Withering Touch
traits.text: (divine, evil, necromancy); When the meladaemon hits with a claw Strike or a creature begins its turn grabbed by the meladaemon, the creature must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature takes 1d6 (1d6) negative damage and becomes fatigued. This fatigue ends when the creature drinks.

actions.text: ⬻ bite +24 (evil, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d12+13 (2d12+13) plus 1d6 (1d6) evil and daemonic famine
